<action type="say">
Understood. The carrier is marking this as delivered and signed for, but the front desk says they don’t have it. Here’s the fastest way to handle this:

1) Double-check local possibilities  
- Confirm the exact shipping name and address on the order confirmation email (sometimes packages get logged under a company name, suite, or “mailroom” instead of a person).  
- Ask your building if there’s:
  - A separate mailroom or package room, or  
  - Another reception desk (e.g., in another lobby or floor).  
- Ask nearby offices/neighbors on your floor in case it was misdelivered but still in the building.

2) Contact UPS with the tracking details  
You’ll want to reference:
- Carrier: UPS  
- Tracking: 1Z999AA10123456784  
- Delivery note: “Left at front desk, signed for by reception” on 2025-11-01 in San Francisco, CA  

When you contact UPS (phone or online chat), say something like:
- “Tracking 1Z999AA10123456784 shows delivered and signed for by ‘reception’ on Nov 1, but my building’s front desk and mailroom have no record of it. Can you provide the exact delivery scan location and the name/signature on file, and open a driver follow‑up / lost package investigation?”

Ask them for:
- Confirmation of the exact address they delivered to  
- The name/signature they recorded  
- A case/claim/reference number

3) Contact the retailer (merchant) with documentation  
After you have the UPS case number, reach out to the store where you bought the headset with:
- Order ID: ODR-107234  
- Tracking: 1Z999AA10123456784  
- UPS case/claim number and summary of what UPS said  
- A short note that front desk has confirmed they did not receive any package under your name on that date

Ask them to:
- Initiate a carrier claim and  
- Either reship the item or issue a refund once their investigation is complete

If you’d like, paste the shipping address from your order confirmation here, and tell me if this was sent to:  
(a) a company office, (b) an apartment building, or (c) a house. I can then draft an exact message you can send to UPS and to the retailer tailored to your situation.</action>
